name: Sweet or Salted Lassi
subtitle: yogurt churned with water until light and foaming, sweet or salted
prepNotes: Sweet and salted are not variations of one drink; they are two drinks. Do not try to make something in between.
The froth is the point. Churn hard, and serve before it settles.

steps.text: Whisk the cold yogurt alone until completely smooth, with no lumps.
Add the cold water gradually, whisking or blending, until it lightens and a head of foam forms.
steps.tip: Gradually. Dumping the water in gives a thin, flat drink.

steps.text: For sweet lassi, add sugar, ground cardamom and a drop of rose water.
For salted, add salt, black salt and roasted cumin instead.
Churn once more to raise the foam and pour into chilled glasses.
Serve at once, with the foam still standing.

storage: Drink fresh. It separates within an hour and never quite recovers.
